title: Pony AI Launches Driverless bZ4X Robotaxi Service With Toyota
summary: Pony AI and Toyota launched fully driverless commercial service with the Gen-7 bZ4X Robotaxi in Guangzhou, aiming for around 1,000 robotaxis in China.
body_markdown:
According to the companies, the model was developed from the ground up for Level 4 autonomous driving, with Pony AI working closely with Toyota on vehicle engineering requirements including redundancy and fail-operational capabilities. The company said it offers Bluetooth-enabled vehicle unlocking, an intelligent voice assistant, in-car entertainment and personalized climate controls. The first mass-produced vehicle rolled off the line in February 2026.


"Bringing the bZ4X Robotaxi into commercial service demonstrates what can be achieved by combining Pony.ai's proven Level 4 autonomous driving technology with Toyota's world-class vehicle engineering and manufacturing expertise," said Dr. Luyi Mo, Vice President of Pony AI.


## Why It Matters for PONY


Pony AI and Toyota have collaborated on multiple generations of Robotaxis since 2019 and have brought Robotaxi services to Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou and Shenzhen, according to the release. In 2023, Pony AI, Toyota Motor China and GAC Toyota decided to establish a joint venture with an investment of more than RMB 1 billion to accelerate the mass production and commercial deployment of Robotaxis. The companies described the bZ4X launch as a major milestone in the partnership, taking the Gen-7 model from development and mass production through testing and validation to commercial deployment.
